chunks: And the one who believed said: 'O my people, indeed I fear for you the like of the Day of the Confedderates.'

key_terms.الَّذِي آمَنَ: The Believer (specifically identified in tradition as Habib al-Najjar)
key_terms.يَوْمِ الْأَحْزَابِ: The Day of the Confedderates (a reference to the Battle of the Confederates or a general day of coalition against faith)

ai.seo_question: Who is the believer in Surah Ghafir and what does he warn his people about?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the role of the 'believer' (often identified as Luqman or a specific companion) who warns his people of the 'Day of the Confedderates,' a period of intense siege and coalition against the faithful. This serves as a thematic precursor to the ultimate divine punishment for those who reject the truth, emphasizing the urgency of heeding the call to monotheism before collective retribution strikes.
